text: My office has heard from residents on Frederick Street between The Esplanade and Henry Lane Terrace regarding the need for traffic calming on their street to address safety concerns and received a petition in support of these changes.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (three speed humps) on Frederick Street, between The Esplanade and Henry Lane Terrace, generally as shown on Attachment 1 to the letter (November 25, 2025) from Deputy Mayor Ausma Malik.
